name: agent-share-web
//: node-datachannel ships its native addon through an `install` script running `prebuild-install -r napi`. Bun skips lifecycle scripts unless the package is trusted, and reads this list only from the workspace root — not from the member that declares the dependency. Without it the module resolves but throws `Cannot find module …/node_datachannel.node` at import, which reads as an unsupported Node version rather than a download that never happened.
